title: Rectangular block
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In this sketch, start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Continue by drawing the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0082), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.0082) to (0.0459, 0.0082), and finally, the fourth line from (0.0459, 0.0082) back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Ensure that the scaled sketch is rotated using Euler angles set to zero degrees and translated using a vector also set to zero. To transform the two-dimensional sketch into a three-dimensional model, extrude the sketch 0.0082 units along the normal direction. Do not extrude in the opposite direction, and create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular block will be a length of 0.7499999857947354 units, a width of 0.008201297311449494 units, and a height of 0.008201297311449494 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0).lineTo(0.75, 0.0082).lineTo(0.0459, 0.0082).close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.0082)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.75   # length along X
W = 0.0082 # width along Y
T = 0.0082 # thickness along Z

# Main bar
bar = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, W, T, centered=(False, False, False))

# Wedge cut to taper one end (visible in TOP view as a taper at the left end)
# The taper runs along the top face toward the left (X=0) end
wedge = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline([
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.10, 0.0),
    (0.0, W)
]).close().extrude(T).translate((0, 0, -0.0001))

r = bar.cut(wedge)

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the geometry based on the front view
# Assuming the front view is a rectangle
width = 0.75
height = 0.0082

# Draw the rectangle in the XY plane
r = r.rect(width, height)

# Extrude the rectangle along the Z-axis to create the part
thickness = 0.0082
r = r.extrude(thickness)
